tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open defensive cybersecurity jobs (SOC, incident response, DFIR, threat hunting, CTI, detection and security engineering) on BlueTeamJobs. Newest first. Each result links to the job page, where the user applies.

tools.name: latest_jobs
tools.description: Jobs first seen on BlueTeamJobs in the last few days, newest first, optionally for one role.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Details of one job: pay, location, clearance, certifications, skills and a short excerpt.

tools.name: get_salary_stats
tools.description: Pay percentiles (USD a year) from salaries published in BlueTeamJobs postings over the last 12 months, by role, US state, seniority or work arrangement. Needs at least 3 postings with pay.

tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: The role categories BlueTeamJobs uses, with open job counts. Use the slugs in other tools.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: Places with open jobs (countries, US states and cities), most jobs first, plus the remote count.
